info.title: Kicbac Payment API
info.description: Form-encoded Kicbac Payment API, Kicbac.js tokenized payment fields, reporting API, and webhook delivery contracts.

tags.name: Payment API
tags.description: Form-encoded transaction, vault, recurring, and invoice operations.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: HTTPS event deliveries signed with Webhook-Signature.

post.description: Use this endpoint for sales, authorizations, captures, voids, refunds, Customer Vault operations, recurring plans/subscriptions, invoices, and Product Manager operations. Tokenize browser payment details with Kicbac.js and send payment_token; do not post raw PAN/CVV from merchant servers.

200.description: Gateway operation result. HTTP 200 does not mean approved; inspect response. response=1 is approved, response=2 is a typed decline result, response=3 is a gateway/processor error.

WebhookSignature.name: Webhook-Signature
WebhookSignature.description: Signature header. Verify HMAC-SHA256(signingKey, nonce + '.' + rawBody) where nonce is t and signature is s.

additionalProperties.description: Gateway supports additional documented processor and Level II/III fields.

security_key.description: Private gateway security key. Never expose this value in browser code.

payment.description: Payment rail selector for void/refund operations.

amount.description: Decimal amount with 1-8 integer digits and an optional 1-2 digit decimal part.

payment_token.description: Single-use Kicbac payment token. Preferred for card and ACH payments.

source_transaction_id.description: Transaction ID to copy card data or vault a previous payment.

transactionid.description: Existing transaction ID for capture, void, refund, or update.

test_mode.description: Process this transaction in gateway test mode.

processor_id.description: Processor identifier for vault, subscription, or invoice routing.

tax.description: Decimal amount with 1-8 integer digits and an optional 1-2 digit decimal part.

shipping.description: Decimal amount with 1-8 integer digits and an optional 1-2 digit decimal part.

ipaddress.description: Cardholder IP address for fraud screening.

partial_payments.description: Split-tender behavior for sale or authorization.

partial_payment_id.description: Partial-payment identifier from the original transaction.

tracking_number.description: Shipment tracking number for capture or transaction update.

shipping_carrier.description: Shipment carrier for capture or transaction update.

void_reason.description: Reason for voiding an EMV transaction.

shipping_postal.description: Destination postal code for a transaction update.

ship_from_postal.description: Origin postal code for a transaction update.

customer_receipt.description: Whether the gateway should send a customer receipt.

shipping_phone.description: Shipping phone for Customer Vault records.

shipping_fax.description: Shipping fax for Customer Vault records.

initial_transaction_id.description: Original CIT transaction ID for follow-up MIT charges.

billing_method.description: Billing method for credential-on-file recurring/standing instruction flows.

billing_total.description: Decimal amount with 1-8 integer digits and an optional 1-2 digit decimal part.

acu_enabled.description: Whether Automatic Card Updater is enabled for the record.

current_plan_id.description: Existing recurring plan ID when editing a plan.

plan_amount.description: Decimal amount with 1-8 integer digits and an optional 1-2 digit decimal part.

plan_payments.description: Number of recurring payments; 0 means until canceled.

day_frequency.description: Positive integer days between recurring charges.

month_frequency.description: Months between recurring charges, from 1 through 24.

day_of_month.description: Day of month for recurring charges, from 1 through 31.

start_date.description: Subscription start date in YYYYMMDD format.

paused_subscription.description: Whether the recurring subscription is paused.

payment_methods_allowed.description: Comma-separated invoice payment methods: cc, ck, or cs.

customer_id.description: Merchant customer identifier for an invoice.

customer_tax_id.description: Customer tax identifier for an invoice.

website.description: Merchant website associated with an invoice.

product_cost.description: Decimal amount with 1-8 integer digits and an optional 1-2 digit decimal part.

product_currency.description: Product price currency, such as USD.

product_tax_amount.description: Decimal amount with 1-8 integer digits and an optional 1-2 digit decimal part.

product_discount_amount.description: Decimal amount with 1-8 integer digits and an optional 1-2 digit decimal part.

product_image_data.description: Base64-encoded JPG, PNG, or GIF image data.

product_image_name.description: Image file name used with product_image_data.

transaction_id.description: Gateway transaction ID or comma-separated IDs.

subscription_id.description: Recurring subscription ID or comma-separated IDs.

mobile_device_license.description: Mobile device license ID, comma-separated IDs, or any_mobile. Mutually exclusive with mobile_device_nickname.

mobile_device_nickname.description: Mobile device nickname. Mutually exclusive with mobile_device_license.

date_search.description: Comma-separated Customer Vault date fields: "created" or "updated".

invoice_status.description: Comma-separated invoice status filters: open, paid, closed, or past_due.

page_number.description: Zero-based page number for paginated reports.

response.description: 1 approved, 2 declined typed result, 3 gateway or processor error.

authcode.description: Authorization code for approved card transactions.

customer_vault_id.description: Customer Vault ID when created or returned.

product_id.description: Product Manager ID when created or updated.

x-kicbac-response-codes.text: No card number on file with issuer.
Declined - retry in a few days.

x-kicbac-response-codes.note: Becomes AuthenticationError when responsetext matches the auth-failure pattern.
